      Telekom expands AI factory in Munich

      More computing power for artificial intelligence. Deutsche Telekom will further expand its AI factory in Munich's Tucherpark.

      Learn more
    • Finance

      More growth, raised guidance, record dividend

      Deutsche Telekom remains on course in the third quarter

      Learn more

    • Reusing network equipment together

      Telekom Equipment Exchange enables excess network equipment to be exchanged across countries. This reduces costs, emissions, and supply dependencies.

      Learn more
    Visit the newsroom

    Facts about Telekom

    Around 200,000 employees work for Telekom in more than 50 countries worldwide. This makes the Group one of the larger international telecommunications providers, with a strong global presence in Europe and the United States.

    As of: 31 December 2025 | Source: Group Profile 2026

    Telekom ranks 11th worldwide in the "Brand Finance Global 500" ranking. It is also the world's most valuable telecommunications brand and the only European company in the top 20.

    As of: 20 January 2026 | Source: Brand Announcement 2026

    Topics to explore

    Visit our topic hubs
    Networks Fiber Optics 5G

    Networks

    Every year, we invest several billion euros in network expansion so we can continue to offer our customers the best network in the future.
